title: Machine Behavior in Relational Moral Dilemmas: Moral Rightness, Predicted Human Behavior, and Model Decisions

live_model.evidence: Sec. "Models": "six representative LLMs: Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-5 mini, o3-mini..."; confirmed "o3-mini-2025-01-31"; Fig 3: "0.53 1.00 1.00 / o3-mini"

prompt.location: Table 1 (severity/closeness/perspective component examples); Sec. 3.1 Template; Appendix A.2 (fraud/burglary categories)
prompt.note: Whistleblower's Dilemma: severity (4) x closeness (4) x crime type (3) x perspective (moral rightness / predicted human behavior / LLM's decision).

claim.metric: Reporting ratio P_report, Moral Rightness perspective
claim.location: Figure 3 ("0.53 1.00 1.00 / o3-mini", first value = Moral Rightness); n_items = 4 severity x 4 closeness x 3 crime types x 3 perspectives = 144 unique prompt instances

data.source: Whistleblower's Dilemma framework fully specified in the paper (Table 1, Sec. 3.1, Appendix A.2); no external dataset needed

notes: Each of the 144 unique prompt instances is evaluated across 3 independent random seeds by the authors' own methodology ("to account for model stochasticity and ensure reproducibility"), giving est_calls=432 directly from the paper's own design. GPT-5-mini (gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07, confirmed dated in the model list) is also tested and would give an equally valid eligible record (Moral Rightness ratio=0.36).
